jobs.title: Anlagemeister Support Infra 80-100% (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Der Anlagemeister – Support Infra gewährleistet durch eine intensive Betreuung seiner ihm zugeteilten Anlagen und Prozesse (Reinstmedien und HVAC) ein nach GMP - Richtlinien funktionsfähiges Produktionsumfeld. Dabei unterstützt er die Projektteams im PCP / PCPSS, welche für die Herstellung von Bioconjugaten verantwortlich sind.
Die Hauptfunktion beinhaltet die Bedienung sowie die korrekte Instandhaltung der Clean-Steam, Purified Water, Water for injection, HeatingVentilation & Air Conditioning Systems HVAC, sowie das Erkennen und Beheben von Störungen der ihm zugeteilten Anlagen und Prozesse.

Was auf Sie wartet:

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur.

• Ein integratives und ethisches Arbeitsumfeld.

• Eine Vielzahl von Vorteilen, abhängig von Funktion und Standort.

Ihre Aufgaben:

• Sicherstellen das die Anlagen für Clean-Steam, Purified Water, Water for injection und Heating Ventilation & Air Conditioning Systems (HVAC), sowie alle Energie-Systeme laufend regelkonform den Betrieben PCP und PCPSS zur Verfügung stehen.

• Bearbeitung, Analyse und Behebung von Abweichungen des Umgebungs- und Wassermonitorings sowie dem Monitoring von Prozessgasen im PCP und PCPSS.

• Erstellung und Pflege der notwendigen SOPs für den zugeteilten Bereich

• Unterstützt Fremdfirmen bei Arbeiten in den Betriebsgebäuden und erteilt Arbeitsbewilligungen in seinem zugeteilten Verantwortungsbereich.

• Stellt sicher, dass alle Kühlgeräte und Kühlräume im PCP und PCPSS laufend und regelkonform zur Verfügung stehen

• Vertretung der zugeteilten Bereiche an Behörden- und Kundenaudits

• die Sicherstellung, dass die ihm zugeteilten Systemen/Apparate kontinuierlich und regelkonform betrieben werden.

• die Gewährleistung von funktionsfähigen Systeme/Apparate für die Produktion durch regelmässige Kontrollen und Wartungen.

• die anlagentechnische Schulung/Ausbildung der Operatoren in seinem Aufgabenbereich.

• Sorgt für Sauberkeit und Ordnung in der Anlage und Utilitybereich

• die Unterstützung des AM Supports im Bereich Betriebshygiene PCP

Was wir suchen:

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Chemie- und Pharmatechnologe (Chemikant) oder Laborant Fachrichtung Chemie/Biologie oder vergleichbare Ausbildung

• Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich GMP Produktion oder Reinstmedien oder im Utility Bereich

• Idealerweise cGMP-Kenntnisse sowie Fachkenntnisse in der Biopharma-Produktion

• Innovativ und ausgeprägtes Organisationstalent

• Hohe Flexibilität, ausgeprägte Teamfähigkeit und hohe Einsatzbereitschaft

Wir bieten attraktive Benefits sowie ein umfassendes Relocation-Paket für talentierte neue Mitarbeitende.

Über Lonza
Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeiter unsere grösste Stärke. An über 30 Standorten auf fünf Kontinenten arbeiten unsere global vernetzten Teams täglich zusammen, um die Medikamente von morgen herzustellen. Unsere Grundwerte: Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortlichkeit, Exzellenz, Leidenschaft und Integrität spiegeln wider, wer wir sind und wie wir zusammenarbeiten. Die Ideen jedes Einzelnen, ob gross oder klein, haben das Potenzial, Millionen von Leben zu verbessern, und genau daran möchten wir Sie teilhaben lassen.

Innovation gedeiht, wenn Menschen unterschiedlichster Herkunft ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven einbringen. Bei Lonza schätzen wir Vielfalt und setzen uns für ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeiter ein. Wenn Sie bereit sind, die bahnbrechenden Ideen unserer Kunden in praktikable Therapien umzusetzen, freuen wir uns, Sie an Bord begrüssen zu dürfen.

Bereit die Zukunft der Life Sciences zu gestalten? Jetzt bewerben

jobs.title: Biotechnologist (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits can be found below.

• Benefits in Visp: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

What you will do:

• Independent operation and execution of upstream related activities according to specified instructions (manufacturing protocols / operating instructions / work instructions / SOP)

• Safe and correct execution of work in compliance with safety regulations, taking into account the cGMP quality requirements

• Responsibility for cleanliness and order at the workplace as well as the assigned rooms and storage areas

• Performing monitoring, maintenance, and cleaning tasks, as well as reporting and rectifying defects and malfunctions in the facility, including their documentation

• Every employee is involved as an equal team member through their active participation in continuous improvement processes

What we are looking for:

• Completed professional training (Apprenticeship)

• Chemical or pharmaceutical-technical training as well as GMP and/or BICO training advantageous

• Good skills in speaking, writing, and comprehension in German or English required.

• Accurate work and documentation practices

• Execution of tasks with a high level of safety and quality awareness

• Willingness to work shifts (4-shift operation) with flexibility in work scheduling

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

German Version:
Der Standort dieser Position ist in Visp, Schweiz. Bei Bedarf steht für berechtigte Kandidaten und ihre Familien Unterstützung beim Umzug zur Verfügung.

Was wir Ihnen bieten:

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur

• Ein inklusiver und ethischer Arbeitsplatz

• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung anerkennen

Zusätzlich zu einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt können Sie zahlreiche Vorteile für Lebensstil, Familie und Freizeit erwarten. Die vollständige Liste unserer lokal zugeschnittenen Benefits finden Sie unten.

Ihre Aufgaben:

• Selbstständige Durchführung und Ausführung von Upstream-bezogenen Tätigkeiten gemäß vorgegebenen Anweisungen (Herstellprotokolle / Arbeitsanweisungen / SOPs)

• Sichere und korrekte Ausführung der Arbeiten unter Einhaltung der Sicherheitsvorschriften sowie unter Berücksichtigung der cGMP-Qualitätsanforderungen

• Verantwortung für Sauberkeit und Ordnung am Arbeitsplatz sowie in den zugewiesenen Räumen und Lagerbereichen

• Durchführung von Überwachungs-, Wartungs- und Reinigungsarbeiten sowie Meldung, Behebung und Dokumentation von Mängeln und Störungen an den Anlagen

• Aktive Mitarbeit als gleichwertiges Teammitglied durch Beteiligung an kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsprozessen

Ihr Profil

• Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung (Lehre)

• Chemische oder pharmazeutisch-technische Ausbildung sowie Kenntnisse in GMP und/oder BICO von Vorteil

• Gute Deutsch- oder Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift erforderlich

• Sorgfältige Arbeits- und Dokumentationsweise

• Durchführung der Aufgaben mit einem hohen Maß an Sicherheits- und Qualitätsbewusstsein

• Bereitschaft zur Schichtarbeit (4-Schicht-Betrieb) sowie Flexibilität in der Arbeitszeitgestaltung

Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeitenden unsere grösste Stärke. Mit über 30 Standorten auf fünf Kontinenten arbeiten unsere global vernetzten Teams jeden Tag zusammen, um die Medikamente von morgen herzustellen. Unsere Kernwerte – Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortlichkeit, Exzellenz, Leidenschaft und Integrität – spiegeln wider, wer wir sind und wie wir zusammenarbeiten. Jede Idee, ob gross oder klein, hat das Potenzial, Millionen von Leben zu verbessern – und genau an dieser Arbeit möchten wir Sie beteiligen.

Innovation gedeiht, wenn Menschen aus unterschiedlichen Hintergründen ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven einbringen. Bei Lonza schätzen wir Vielfalt und setzen uns für ein inklusives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeitenden ein. Wenn Sie bereit sind, die bahnbrechenden Ideen unserer Kunden in umsetzbare Therapien zu verwandeln, freuen wir uns darauf, Sie an Bord zu begrüssen.

Bereit, die Zukunft der Life Sciences mitzugestalten? Bewerben Sie sich jetzt.

jobs.description:
Location: the actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

The QA Specialist (QA On The Floor) is responsible to the Associate Director, Head of QA Operations BioAtrium  in joining a strong and innovative team that is perceived as a main contributor to the success of the large scale mammalian operations in our future BioAtrium site.  A great candidate will have strong GMP mindset, have leadership capabilities, envisioning and driving teamwork, quality culture, and innovation with the goal of becoming a role model within Lonza. We are looking for someone comfortable working in a matrix organization, effective with cross-functional projects, someone who can conceptualize where we need to be, how to get there, and drive ideas to completion.  The QA Specialist will within the QA Operations team as QA On The Floor, but will support other QA Ops teams (e.g. Clean Utilities and Environmental Monitoring, QA for QC and Electronic Batch Record Review) They will interact with the the other Operational teams at BioAtrium like Production, Engineering and Project Management.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits can be found below.
Benefits in Visp: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

What you will do:

• Comply with, Develop, implement and monitor quality procedures to ensure compliance with GxP standards, corporate policies, Swissmedic, FDA and other regulatory body regulations and guidelines.

• Support all QA operations activities concerning SOP landscape, electronic batch records, training,  deviation- / CAPA- and change control management

• Support all audits and inspections

• Identify and implement Lean / OPEX approaches in Quality and foster improvement projects

• Provide KPI reporting and execute action plans to address opportunities for improvement

• Work collaboratively with QA Operations and QA department colleagues

What we are looking for:

• Academic degree in a Life Science discipline/ Engineering/ Quality Management or related field

• Experience in working on a regulated Medical device, Drug product or Drug Substance site

• Experience with Lean / Operational Excellence / Six Sigma

• GMP compliance expertise

• Ability to interface and communicate directly with customers and regulatory bodies

• Excellent written and oral communication to include accurate and legible documentation

• Ability to work on call and/or out of normal working hours on site

• Fluency in English is required, German language skills are an advantage

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.
Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.
Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland.

The Trainee will be part and responsible to support the logistics operational excellence team in Visp and it’s project leads within the execution of EO improvement/efficiency projects. The trainee will support from the definition phase to the improvement / implementation phase to optimize E2E Logistics processes at the visp site.

The role of this person is to support and maintain structures (e.g. organization, decision, communication, documentation flows, in accordance with project management, in order to respect project management processes and increase project team efficiency.

The hired candidate will be responsible for specific project tasks. These tasks will include developing metrics, tracking progress, prepare and orchestrate workshops and reporting to management. The purpose is to assist project leads and the logistics teams.

They will also act as an active support for preparing regular reviews of the ongoing projects and highlight current issues/gaps.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OBoAVhfTkTQ

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture. An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

• In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits.

​Our full list of tailored local benefits can be found below.

• Benefits in Visp: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

What you will do:

• Responsible for internal coordination and support of project tasks in order to balance the effort of the overall Logistics and Supply Chain team.

• Participate and support in coordinating, issuing project related general and specific documents, reports and presentations.

• Co-ordination and follow up with cross-functional departments (Logistics, Plant Logistics, Supply Chain), tracking activities and deliverables (like list of deliverables, installation list and timely issue of deliverables).

• Responsible for the development of PowerBI dashboards.

• Organize internal workshops and support team members to establish agendas, meeting minutes, actions lists etc.

• Support daily management activities by providing assistance in monitoring and tracking important metrics on a daily and monthly basis. Aid in the implementation and tracking of planned activities.

What we are looking for:

• Degree or ongoing studies in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or a related field (B.Sc., M.Sc., Dipl. Ing., or equivalent).

• Initial knowledge or strong interest in chemical and/or pharmaceutical supply chains is a plus.

• Curiosity and openness to work across different disciplines.

• Motivated and proactive team player with a willingness to learn and contribute.

• Good knowledge of common IT tools; experience with SharePoint, Power BI, and Excel is an advantage.

• Ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a team environment.

• Flexible mindset with the ability to adapt to changing priorities, timelines, and tasks.

• Basic analytical and problem‑solving skills with a desire to develop them further.

• Clear and confident written and verbal communication skills.

• Willingness to support administrative and organizational tasks as part of the learning role.

• Reliable and persistent in following up with partners to collect required information.

• Interest in process improvement methodologies; Lean Six Sigma knowledge or certification is a plus.

• Good command of English and German.

• First exposure to a cGMP environment is beneficial but not required.

About Lonza

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

jobs.title: Elektroinstallateur EFZ 80-100% (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Umzugsunterstützung steht berechtigen Kandidaten und ihren Familien bei Bedarf zur Verfügung.

Lonza ist heute ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Life Sciences, welches auf drei Kontinenten tätig ist. Wir sind in der Wissenschaft tätig, jedoch gibt es keine Zauberformel dafür, wie wir die Arbeit angehen. Unsere wichtigste wissenschaftliche Lösung sind talentierte Mitarbeitende, die zusammenarbeiten und Ideen entwickeln, die anderen Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Gegenzug steuern unsere Mitarbeitenden ihre Karriere selbstständig. Denn ihre Ideen, ob gross und klein, verbessern die Welt. Und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der wir Teil haben möchten.

Für unseren Standort in Visp suchen wir einen Elektroinstallateur EFZ.

Was wir dir bieten:

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur

• Einen integrativen und ethischen Arbeitsplatz

• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung anerkennen

• Neben einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt erwarten dich zahlreiche Vorteile in den Bereichen Lifestyle, Familie und Freizeit. Die vollständige Liste unserer globalen Leistungen findest du auch unter: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

Deine Aufgaben:

• Durchführung von Installations-, und Inbetriebsetzungsarbeiten von EMR Anlagen (Elektro-, Mess- und Regeltechnik)

• Präventive Instandhaltung und Störungsbehebung von EMR Anlagen

• Messungen und Sicherheitskontrollen nach CH-Normen

• Dokumentation nach GxP Richtlinien (Datenintegrität)

• Betreuung und Unterstützung von Lehrlingen

Dein Profil:

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung zum Elektroinstallateur EFZ

• Grundkenntnisse Mess- und Regeltechnik sind von Vorteil

• Bereitschaft zu kontinuierlicher Weiterbildung

• Freude an abteilungsübergreifender Arbeit sowie selbstständiges und flexibles Arbeiten im Team

• Zuverlässigkeit, Belastbarkeit sowie unternehmerisches Handeln und offene, direkte Kommunikation

• Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil

Lonzas Produkte und Services wirken sich täglich positiv auf Millionen von Menschen aus. Für uns stellt dies nicht nur eine grosse Ehre, sondern auch eine grosse Verantwortung, dar. Wie wir unsere Geschäftsergebnisse erreichen ist für uns genauso wichtig wie unsere Erfolge selbst. Bei Lonza wird Respekt grossgeschrieben und wir schützen sowohl unsere Mitarbeiter als auch unsere Umwelt. Erfolg für uns bedeutet moralisch vertretbarer Fortschritt.

Zu Lonza kommen Menschen, die Herausforderungen annehmen und mit ihrer Kreativität im Bereich Life Science neue Ideen für komplexe Problemstellungen entwickeln. Zusammen leisten wir einen Beitrag, der das Leben vieler Menschen auf der ganzen Welt verbessern kann. Dies bietet ihnen die Gewissheit und die Zufriedenheit, mit der eigenen Arbeit wirklich einen Unterschied zu machen.

Bereit, die Zukunft der Life Sciences mitzugestalten? Dann bewirb dich jetzt!

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

jobs.title: Operator Visual Inspection 80-100%
jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Stein, AG, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Join our brand new Fill‑Finish facility in Stein as an Operator Visual Inspection, performing manual inspections today while supporting the transition to semi‑ and fully automated processes. This includes qualification runs and routine inspections in a controlled darkroom setting. We’re looking for a motivated and resilient individual who thrives in structured environments, follows GMP guidelines, and contributes to both the project phase and routine production excellence. Check out Your Career in Drug Product  Services at Lonza!

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits can be found below.

• Benefits in Stein: https://bit.ly/42DlBDk

What you will do:

• Manual, semi-automated, and fully automated visual inspection of liquid and lyophilized vials and syringes in a cleanroom setting

• Classification of defects in accordance with regulations

• Regular qualification and requalification using existing test sets

• Inspection of test runs / threshold studies

• Support in deviations and root cause analysis

What we are looking for:

• Strong attention to detail and cleanliness, with an uncompromising approach to quality and safety

• Willing to work in a cleanroom

• Experience in a GMP production environment is highly desirable

• Experience in visual inspection, including relevant further training is a plus

• Completed vocational training (e.g. as a chemical or pharmaceutical technologist) is an advantage

• Fluency in German is a must and basic knowledge of English

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.
Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.
Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

jobs.title: BIO Operator P1P2 4 Schicht (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Der tatsächliche Ort dieser Stelle befindet sich in Visp, Schweiz. Berechtigten Bewerbern und ihren Familien steht bei Bedarf Unterstützung beim Umzug zur Verfügung.

Was auf Sie wartet

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur

• Ein integratives und ethisches Arbeitsumfeld

• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung anerkennen

• Eine Vielzahl von Benefits, abhängig von Funktion und Standort

Die vollständige Liste unserer globalen Benefits finden Sie hier:
https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

Ihre Aufgaben

• Selbstständiges Fahren der ihm vertrauten Teile der Produktionsanlage gemäss Vorgabedokumenten (Herstellungsprotokolle/ Bedienungsanleitungen / Arbeitsanweisungen / SOP)

• Sichere und richtige Arbeitsausführung unter Einhaltung der Sicherheitsvorschriften unter Berücksichtigung der cGMP Qualitätsanforderungen

• Verantwortung für Sauberkeit und Ordnung am Arbeitsplatz sowie den zugewiesenen Räumen und Lagern

• Erledigen von Überwachungs-, Instandhaltungs-, und Reinigungsarbeiten sowie das Melden und Beheben von Mängeln und Störungen in der Anlage inklusive deren Dokumentation

• Jeder Mitarbeiter / in ist als gleichwertiges Teammitglied durch Seine / Ihre aktive Mithilfe an kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsprozessen  beteiligt

Was wir suchen

• Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung  vorausgesetzt

• Chemische oder pharmatechnologische Ausbildung sowie GMP und / oder BICO Ausbildung von Vorteil

• Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort, Schrift und Verständnis

• Akkurate Arbeits- und Dokumentationsweise

• Ausführung der Arbeiten mit hohem Sicherheits- und Qualitätsbewusstsein

• Bereitschaft zur Schichtarbeit ( 4 Schicht-Betrieb) mit Flexibilität bei der Arbeitseinteilung

Über Lonza

Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeitenden unsere grösste Stärke. An über 30 Standorten auf fünf Kontinenten arbeiten unsere global vernetzten Teams täglich zusammen, um die Medikamente von morgen herzustellen.
Unsere Grundwerte – Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortlichkeit, Exzellenz, Leidenschaft und Integrität – spiegeln wider, wer wir sind und wie wir zusammenarbeiten.
Innovation entsteht durch Vielfalt. Deshalb schätzen wir unterschiedliche Perspektiven und fördern ein integratives Arbeitsumfeld für alle Mitarbeitenden. Wenn Sie bereit sind, die Ideen unserer Kunden in wirksame Therapien umzusetzen, freuen wir uns, Sie an Bord begrüssen zu dürfen.

Bereit, die Zukunft der Life Sciences zu gestalten? Jetzt bewerben.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

jobs.title: CQV Engineer / Qualification & Validation Engineer 80-100% (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Join our team at Lonza in Visp, Switzerland as a CQV Engineer / Qualification & Validation Engineer (m/f/d). Work alongside an outstanding team dedicated to maintaining flawless operations and premier standards. This role provides an exciting chance to contribute to our dynamic environment, directly improving the quality and efficiency of our processes. Take part in qualifying and validating brand-new process engineering equipment and facilities, promoting continuous improvement and innovation.

Your Career with Lonza in Visp, Switzerland

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. The full list of our local tailored benefits in Visp: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

What you will do:

• Develop and maintain commissioning and qualification documents for new plants, including PQs for critical systems and ongoing SLC support post-implementation.

• Supervise and resolve deviations, manage changes (GEP and GMP), and implement CAPAs effectively.

• Coordinate efforts between internal teams and external service providers and suppliers to ensure seamless project execution.

• Present qualification documents during audits and inspections, showcasing the outstanding standards maintained.

What we are looking for:

• Graduate from a technical school (HF) / university of applied sciences (FH) or hold a university degree

• Proven experience in a regulated GMP environment, specifically in commissioning, qualification, and validation of systems like refrigerators, freezers, clean media, and process engineering equipment

• Strong proficiency in MS Office; familiarity with COMOS, DMS, Kneat, TrackWise, and SAP is advantageous

• Proficient in both written and spoken German and/or English

• Demonstrate independent, flexible work habits, with excellent communication skills and a structured, focused approach to tasks.

• Open to new ideas, agile in thinking, and proactive in problem-solving.

About Lonza:

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

jobs.title: QA Manager – Contamination Control Strategy 80-100% (f/m/d)

titleByLocale.it: Responsabile QA – Strategia di Controllo della Contaminazione 80-100% (f/m/d)

jobs.description:
Location: The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

You will own defined parts of the site Contamination Control Strategy at one of the largest biologics manufacturing sites in the world, where your decisions shape how a sustained microbial state of control is held shift after shift, batch after batch. You will work alongside colleagues from across the globe, in a site set in the Swiss Alps of the Valais.

What you will get :

• A place in an inclusive, dynamic, and passionate team.

• An unusually broad range of topics and disciplines to accelerate your professional growth and development.

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits can be found below.

• Benefits in Visp: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

What you will do:

• Own defined areas within the site Contamination Control Strategy and hold a sustained microbial state of control across facilities, equipment, processes, and supporting systems.

• Act as the technical lead for contamination control, hygiene, and microbiological QC topics in deviations, change controls, root cause investigations, impact assessments, and CAPAs, including their definition and follow-up.

• Ensure equipment, facility, and process hygienic integrity across the full lifecycle, from design and qualification through start-up, routine use, cleaning and sanitization, maintenance, and bioburden remediation.

• Provide visible shopfloor presence, hands-on technical support, day-to-day guidance, and leadership on contamination control, hygiene, and microbiological QC topics, including GEMBAs, oversight of microbiological methods and testing, and alignment of data trending practices with site contamination control requirements.

• Develop and improve hygiene concepts, gowning expectations, aseptic behavior, microbial hold times, bioburden and endotoxin control strategies, and the associated risk assessments.

• Represent CCS and microbiological quality topics in projects, audits, regulatory inspections, and cross-functional governance forums spanning QA, QC, MSAT, Engineering, Validations, and Operations.

• Drive continuous improvement, KPI delivery, training, and technical guidance commensurate with the risk profile of the site, and stay current with evolving regulatory expectations and industry best practice.

What we are looking for:

• Academic degree in Microbiology/ Biotechnology/ Pharmaceutical Sciences or another relevant scientific discipline.

• Significant experience in GMP-regulated pharmaceutical or biotech manufacturing, with strong exposure to contamination control, microbiological quality, or sterility assurance-related topics.

• Hands-on experience in contamination control strategy, microbial risk management, and contamination prevention in manufacturing environments is highly desired.

• A Quality Assurance background is preferred, particularly in roles involving contamination control, deviations, change controls, investigations, CAPAs, and inspection readiness.

• Good knowledge of GMP requirements and relevant regulatory expectations, including EU GMP Annex 1, EudraLex Volume 4, and applicable pharmacopoeial requirements and microbiological compendia.

• Understanding of key contamination control elements such as environmental and utilities monitoring, hygiene, gowning, aseptic practices, microbial control strategies, cleanroom behaviors, and qualified state maintenance.

• Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across QA, QC, Engineering, Operations, and Microbiology.

• Fluency in English (written and spoken), German is an advantage.

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.
Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.
Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

jobs.title: HR Engagement & Communication Intern 80-100%
jobs.description:
We are seeking an enthusiastic and communicative intern who is eager to contribute to impactful HR communications at Lonza. This position offers a unique opportunity to gain hands‑on experience at the intersection of HR, communication, and organizational culture.

What you will do:

• Support HR Senior Management in preparing, structuring, and refining targeted HR communications for different internal audiences (e.g., HR community, leaders, employees)

• Summarize and translate HR strategies, initiatives, and outcomes into clear, concise, and engaging communication formats.

• Prepare and maintain HR-related content for internal platforms, in particular CoLab, ensuring information is up‑to‑date, easy to understand, and aligned with Lonza messaging, including review and approval by Group Internal Communications.

• Support external-facing HR communications, including LinkedIn posts and employer branding–related content, in close alignment with HR and Corporate Communications.

• Actively promote HR initiatives, programs, and engagement activities, helping to increase visibility, awareness, and participation across Lonza.

• Support the creation of presentations, newsletters, announcements, talking points, and briefing materials for HR leadership meetings, townhalls, and global forums, in alignment with Group Design guidelines and including review and final approval from the Brand & Design team.

• Coordinate timelines, inputs, and materials related to HR campaigns, engagement activities, and key people moments across the year.

• Review, edit, and ensure quality and consistency of HR communication materials (tone of voice, structure, branding).

• Provide general administrative and ad‑hoc support to the CHRO, the Head of HR Corporate Functions, and the wider HR leadership team as required.

•  Excellent written and spoken English; additional languages are an advantage.

What we are looking for:

• Studies (BA and/or Master) in Business Administration, Human Resources, Communications, Social Sciences, Marketing, or a related field.

• Strong interest in HR, internal communications, engagement, and organizational culture.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; ability to structure complex content into clear key messages.

• Good understanding of integrated communication, understanding stakeholders’ needs (what’s in it for them) and optimal channels for where/how to reach them.

• High proficiency in MS Office, especially PowerPoint (storytelling, slide design) andWord; experience with collaboration platforms (e.g., CoLab, SharePoint) is an advantage.

• Affinity for digital communication channels and social media, including LinkedIn.

• Proactive, reliable, and well‑organized working style, with the ability to handle multiple topics in parallel and to collaborate effectively in a global, matrix organization.

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

titleByLocale.it: Bioprocess Ingegnere in USP / DSP / BioConjugates
titleByLocale.en: Bioprocess Engineer in USP / DSP / BioConjugates
titleByLocale.de: Bioprocess Ingenieur in USP / DSP / BioConjugates
titleByLocale.fr: Bioprocess Ingénieur in USP / DSP / BioConjugates

jobs.description:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is dedicated people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

As the global manufacturing partner for many different customers, we are increasing manufacturing capacity. As other businesses face increasing economic uncertainty, we are fortunate to have opportunities for expansion. Through this new collaboration, our work will have a significant, direct and long-term impact on the management of this global pandemic.
In order to support our continued growth Lonza is seeking Bioprocess Engineers with a relevant background in Life Sciences and a passion for Biotechnology to join our talent community in Visp, Switzerland. Become part of this great opportunity and join our team by applying for the position as Bioprocess Engineer in Upstream Processing or Downstream Processing or BioConjugate Manufacturing.

Key responsibilities:

• Ensure that operational activities for clinical and/or commercial manufacturing are performed on-time and within given safety and quality standards

• Act as the functional lead for preparation, manufacturing execution, cleaning and changeover in the assigned area

• Lead of one or more defined USP areas (e.g. seed train, main cultivation or harvest) for the production of therapeutic proteins with either mammalian or microbial expressions systems (Bioprocess Engineer USP)

• In charge of one or more defined DSP areas (e.g. gain, polishing or filling) for the purification of therapeutic proteins from either mammalian or microbial cells (Bioprocess Engineer DSP)

• Responsible for entire processes or process units for clinical and commercial manufacturing projects in therapeutic BioConjugates like Antibody Drug Conjugates (ADC) (Bioprocess Engineer BioConjugates)

Key requirements:

• Master’s Degree or equivalent experience in Biotechnology, Biochemical Engineering, Biochemistry or related Life Science subject, or Bachelor’s holder with experience in pharma production

• Knowledge in either USP (such as bioreactors) or DSP units (such as chromatography)

• Working experience in biomanufacturing would be an advantage

• GMP experience and understanding of bioprocess technology

• Excellent communication skills in English, good German skills of advantage

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.

People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a significant difference.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

Our greatest scientific solution is dedicated people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of. As the global manufacturing partner for many different customers, we are increasing manufacturing capacity. As other businesses face increasing economic uncertainty, we are fortunate to have opportunities for expansion. Through this new collaboration, our work will have a significant, direct and long-term impact on the management of this global pandemic. In order to support our continued growth Lonza is seeking Bioprocess Engineers with a relevant background in Life Sciences and a passion for Biotechnology to join our talent community in Visp, Switzerland. Become part of this great opportunity and join our team by applying for the position as Bioprocess Engineer in Upstream Processing or Downstream Processing or BioConjugate Manufacturing. Key responsibilities:
• Ensure that operational activities for clinical and/or commercial manufacturing are performed on-time and within given safety and quality standards
• Act as the functional lead for preparation, manufacturing execution, cleaning and changeover in the assigned area
• Lead of one or more defined USP areas (e.g. seed train, main cultivation or harvest) for the production of therapeutic proteins with either mammalian or microbial expressions systems (Bioprocess Engineer USP)
• In charge of one or more defined DSP areas (e.g. gain, polishing or filling) for the purification of therapeutic proteins from either mammalian or microbial cells (Bioprocess Engineer DSP)
• Responsible for entire processes or process units for clinical and commercial manufacturing projects in therapeutic BioConjugates like Antibody Drug Conjugates (ADC) (Bioprocess Engineer BioConjugates) Key requirements:
• Master’s Degree or equivalent experience in Biotechnology, Biochemical Engineering, Biochemistry or related Life Science subject, or Bachelor’s holder with experience in pharma production
• Knowledge in either USP (such as bioreactors) or DSP units (such as chromatography)
• Working experience in biomanufacturing would be an advantage
• GMP experience and understanding of bioprocess technology
• Excellent communication skills in English, good German skills of advantage Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically. People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a significant difference. Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Specialist Ibex® 100% (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is dedicated people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

Ibex® Solutions (www.ibex.lonza.com) is a modular build complex to develop and manufacture biological products. It enables companies to get access to a complete solution, gaining speed and achieving a simplified value chain.
The Ibex® Complex is our contribution to the medicine of tomorrow and possibly the next step in your career?

At our location in Visp, in the canton of Valais, we are constantly looking for Biotechnologists with a relevant background at all levels in Life Sciences in order to support our growth in several business units.

Key responsibilities:

• Assignment in various functions within the production facilities in compliance with safety regulations and consideration of cGMP quality requirements.

• Recognition, interpretation and elimination of deviations

• Execution of production steps incl. recording and calculations

• Support in training of new team members

Key requirements:

• Completed chemical / biopharmaceutical education

• Professional experience in pharmaceutical production as an operator/production technician etc

• Safety-conscious work

• Knowledge of process engineering

• Fluent English

• German language skills advantageous

• Willingness to work in shifts (e.g. 4-shift pattern) with flexible work scheduling

jobs.title: Manufacturing Specialist Mammalian 100% (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is dedicated people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

Due to the growth at our site in Visp, we are currently looking for several Manufacturing Specialists for our Ibex-facility. In this role, you will be responsible for performing operational activities of assigned manufacturing projects in specific areas (Up-stream or Down-stream processing).

Key responsibilities:

• Complete manufacturing activities in either the Upstream Processing or Downstream Processing area according to cGMP guidelines, ensuring batch execution, evaluating test results, resolving issues, troubleshoot manufacturing equipment and make recommendations for resolution

• Support the preparation of SHE (Safety, Health, environment), EM (Environmental Monitoring), operation and cleaning risk assessment for the assigned products and the implementation and control of defined measures

• Assist document preparation (e.g. electronic batch records, SOPs) specific to the assigned production area

• Review production documentation and work on deviations, change requests and implementation of CAPAs to ensure high-quality GMP standards

• Engage in Capital investment projects for building and commissioning of new manufacturing units as manufacturing expert. Responsible for delivering all input required for the specific set-up, commissioning and qualification of the manufacturing suites and equipment

• Responsible for the training of the manufacturing staff on specific equipment or standard operations

Key requirements:

• Completed chemical / biopharmaceutical education or corresponding training qualification, Bachelor / Master's degree or equivalent experience in Biotechnology, Biology, Biochemical Engineering or related fields is an advantage

• Sound knowledge of biotechnological processes either in the area of microbial and/or mammalian cultivation or protein purification

• Excellent communication skills, great teammate, driven and solution-oriented

• Fluency in English required, fluency in German is considered a plus

• Open to work in shift (4-shift system)

• Basic GMP understanding is a plus

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as meaningful as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. jobs.title: Supply Chain Lead DP Development Services (f/m/d)

titleByLocale.it: Supply Chain Lead DP Development Services (f/m/d)
titleByLocale.en: Supply Chain Lead DP Development Services (f/m/d)
titleByLocale.fr: Chaîne d'approvisionnement Lead DP Development Services (f/m/d)

jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Basel Stücki, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

For Drug Product Services (DPS), our successful DP focused branch located in Basel, Switzerland, we have exciting opportunities!  Become part of a group that enables its customers to meet some of the greatest challenges in patient treatment. Are you ready for your next challenge? Apply now and join this outstanding team as Supply Chain Lead DPS Development Services!

The Supply Chain Lead DPS Development Services is accountable for consistent and flawless supply chain execution at the site level. On that purpose, the person is translating customers’ demand into executable schedules for which material, asset and resources are available and develops and sets practices in alignment with the Lonza global supply chain. The role is also responsible for operational buying of materials and warehouse/ logistics operations.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

What you will do:

• SC Team management including optimal resource's allocation, hiring, gap analysis and talent development

• Flawless coordination of site planning alignment (from demand to execution)

• Ensuring through the warehouse/ logistics team that the movement of material across the site and distribution of products to the customers is conducted

• All medium- and short- term planning processes to ensure fully integrated asset capacity planning, labor planning and material planning (monthly S&OP, weekly operations planning and daily tier process)

• Lead the local monthly S&OP meeting, provide a monthly forecast of all site-based deliverables, supports Finance/Controlling/Program Management financial outlook for the site as agreed at the meeting and submit to Platform Planner

• Robust sourcing information operational buying activities

• Oversee Inventory Management and Materials Flows

• Accountable for Planning and Material Master Data and as well SAP Blueprint implementation, execution and certification

What we are looking for:

• Degree or equivalent experience in Life Sciences with solid knowledge in APICS CPIM professional standards

• Over 10 years of work experience in
a) Laboratory Planning and execution – in a testing or development lab and
b) Supply Chain / Logistics - in a manufacturing organization

• Strong SAP background with skills in financial, scheduling and materials planning is a must (Planview background an additional benefit)

• Very strong leadership skills with a proven ability to motivate and manage teams not only in a traditional hierarchical organizational structure and but also enable teams in a matrix structure

• Demonstrates the courage and integrity to engage in difficult conversations with internal teams and management when needed, fostering transparency, growth, and collaboration

• Ability to build a highly collaborative and inclusive environment necessary for a team to be effective

• Strong communication and presentation skills, ability to present ideas in a clear and concise manner

• Fluent in English, German is a strong asset

About Lonza

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

Ihr Profil

jobs.title: Bioprocess Engineer Mammalian (USP/DSP)
jobs.description:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is dedicated people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

As the global manufacturing partner for many different customers, we are increasing manufacturing capacity. As other businesses face growing economic uncertainty, we are fortunate to have opportunities for expansion. Through this new collaboration, our work will have a significant, direct and long-term impact on the management of this global pandemic.
In order to support our continued growth Lonza is seeking Bioprocess Engineers with a relevant background in Life Sciences and a passion for Biotechnology to join our talent community in Visp, Switzerland. Become part of this great opportunity and join our team by applying for the position as Bioprocess Engineer within our Mammalian Business Division either in Upstream Processing or Downstream Processing.

Key responsibilities:

• Ensure that operational activities for clinical and/or commercial manufacturing are performed on-time and within given safety and quality standards

• Act as the functional lead for preparation, manufacturing execution, cleaning and changeover in the assigned area

• Lead of one or more defined USP areas (e.g. seed train, main cultivation or harvest) for the production of therapeutic proteins with either mammalian or microbial expressions systems (Bioprocess Engineer USP)

• In charge of one or more defined DSP areas (e.g. gain, polishing or filling) for the purification of therapeutic proteins from either mammalian (Bioprocess Engineer DSP)

Key requirements:

• Master’s Degree or equivalent experience in Biotechnology, Biochemical Engineering, Biochemistry or related Life Science subject, or Bachelor’s holder with experience in pharma production

• Knowledge in either USP (such as bioreactors) or DSP units (such as chromatography)

• Couple of years working experience in biomanufacturing required

• GMP experience and understanding of bioprocess technology

• Excellent communication skills in English, good German skills of advantage

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.

People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving sophisticated problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a significant difference.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

jobs.description:
Am Standort Visp bietet Lonza im Sustainability Team einen Praktikumsplatz im Rahmen des praxisintegrierten Bachelorstudiums (PiBS) in Zusammenarbeit mit der Hochschule Luzern (HSLU) an.

Das PiBS-Modell ermöglicht Maturandinnen und Maturanden den direkten Einstieg in ein Bachelorstudium im MINT-Bereich, ohne vorgängiges Praxisjahr. Während des Studiums arbeiten die Studierenden 40 – 100% im Unternehmen (je nach Studiumsmodell) und besuchen parallel die Lehrveranstaltungen an der HSLU. So verbinden sie Theorie und Praxis von Anfang an.

Als PiBS-Studierende/r bei Lonza sammeln Sie wertvolle Praxiserfahrung in einem internationalen Life-Science-Umfeld und arbeiten aktiv an Projekten im Bereich Nachhaltigkeit und Ressourceneffizienz mit, während Sie ihr Bachelorstudium an der Hochschule Luzern – Technik & Architektur absolvieren.

Was auf Sie wartet:

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur.

• Ein integratives und ethisches Arbeitsumfeld.

• Eine Vielzahl von Vorteilen, abhängig von Funktion und Standort.

Ihre Aufgaben:

• Allgemeine Tätigkeiten im Bereit Nachhaltigkeit und Ressourcenschonung mit Fokus auf Abwasserminimierung und CO2-Emissionen

• Mitwirken im Site Sustainability Team Visp zur Projekt Identifizierung und Umsetzung

• Bearbeitung von Nachhaltigkeitsprojekt, um Energien und Abwasserströme zu minimieren

• Technische Anlagenoptimierung mit Fokus auf Verbrennungs- und Verwertungsanalgen sowie Abwasserreinigungsanlagen

• Evaluierung von technisch und ökonomischen Machbarkeiten am Standort, um mittel- und langfristige Nachhaltigkeitsziele zu erreichen

Was wir suchen

• Maturant/in mit Studienplatz an der Hochschule Luzern (HSLU) im PiBS (Praxisintegriertes Bachelorstudium) in den Studienrichtungen Energie- und Umwelttechnik sowie Maschinentechnik

• Interesse an den Themen Nachhaltigkeit, CO2-Reduktion und allgemeiner Ressourcenschonung

• Proaktive, selbständige und flexible Arbeitsweise

• Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Schrift und Sprache. Englischkenntnisse vorteilhaft

Über Lonza:
Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeiter unsere größte Stärke. An über 30 Standorten auf fünf Kontinenten arbeiten unsere global vernetzten Teams täglich zusammen, um die Medikamente von morgen herzustellen. Unsere Grundwerte – Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortlichkeit, Exzellenz, Leidenschaft und Integrität – spiegeln wider, wer wir sind und wie wir zusammenarbeiten. Die Ideen jedes Einzelnen, ob groß oder klein, haben das Potenzial, Millionen von Leben zu verbessern, und genau daran möchten wir Sie teilhaben lassen.

Innovation gedeiht, wenn Menschen unterschiedlichster Herkunft ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven einbringen. Bei Lonza schätzen wir Vielfalt und setzen uns für ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeiter ein. Wenn Sie bereit sind, die bahnbrechenden Ideen unserer Kunden in praktikable Therapien umzusetzen, freuen wir uns, Sie an Bord begrüßen zu dürfen.

Bereit, die Zukunft der Life Sciences zu gestalten? Jetzt bewerben.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

jobs.description:
Ort: Visp (Schweiz)
Bei Bedarf steht für berechtigte Kandidaten und ihre Familien Unterstützung beim Umzug zur Verfügung.

In dieser Rolle unterstützt du die Qualitätskontrolle der Biologics-Produktion am Standort Visp. Deine Arbeit trägt direkt dazu bei, dass Medikamente weltweit sicher und wirksam eingesetzt werden können. Der Job bietet Abwechslung, Verantwortung und attraktive Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten – im modernen Labor und im gut strukturierten 4‑Schicht‑Modell.

Was du bekommst

• Ein modernes Laborumfeld mit erstklassiger Ausstattung.

• Eine inklusive, kollegiale Arbeitskultur mit klaren Entwicklungspfaden.

• ÖV-Unterstützung, Aktienprogramme, erweiterte Elternzeit und starke Pensionskassenleistungen; Alle lokalen Benefits am Standort Visp

• Drei interne Analysten-Stufen für eine Karriere ohne Führungsverantwortung und die Möglichkeit bis zu 150 verschiedene Methoden zu erlernen.

• Vielfältige Weiterbildungs- und Spezialisierungsmöglichkeiten.

Dein Arbeitsplatz
Unser Labor wurde 2022 neu gebaut – modern, effizient und technisch auf dem neuesten Stand. Wir leben eine offene Feedback-Kultur: Verbesserungsvorschläge von Analystinnen und Analysten werden ernst genommen, bewertet und aktiv umgesetzt (Kaizen-Prinzip). Wir wollen jeden Tag besser werden – gemeinsam und mit echtem Teamgeist.

Was du tust

• Du führst mikrobiologische, biochemische und physikalisch‑chemische Analysen unter GMP-Bedingungen durch, z.B. Bioburden, Endotoxin, HPLC / Chromatographie, UV oder TOC

• Du stellst im 4‑Schicht‑Betrieb die zeitkritische Analyse und Freigabe von Produktions-Chargen sicher.

• Du dokumentierst Ergebnisse präzise und arbeitest eng mit verschiedenen Teams zusammen.

• Du unterstützt kontinuierliche Verbesserungsprozesse nach dem Kaizen-Prinzip.

• Du entwickelst dich fachlich weiter – als Spezialist/in oder Generalist/in, je nach deinen Interessen.

Was du mitbringst

• Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Laborant/in EFZ oder eine naturwissenschaftlich-technische Ausbildung.

• Erste Laborerfahrung und GMP-Kenntnisse sind ein Vorteil.

• Freude an präziser Laborarbeit, Verantwortung und Qualitätsbewusstsein.

• Deutsch-Kenntnisse mindestens auf Niveau B1; Englisch-Kenntnisse von Vorteil.

• Bereitschaft zur Arbeit im 4‑Schicht‑Modell (Frühschicht 5:00Uhr) und Wohnort in erreichbarer Nähe zu Visp.

• Hands-on Mentalität, Teamfähigkeit und Motivation für langfristige Entwicklung.

Über Lonza
Lonza zählt zu den weltweit führenden Unternehmen der Life‑Sciences‑Industrie. Unsere Teams entwickeln und produzieren gemeinsam Therapien und Technologien, die das Leben von Menschen weltweit verbessern. Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortung, Qualität, Leidenschaft und Integrität prägen unsere Arbeitsweise. Jede Idee – groß oder klein – kann einen Unterschied machen.
Wir fördern Vielfalt und Inklusion und schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem alle Mitarbeitenden sich einbringen und weiterentwickeln können. Wenn du Teil eines Teams sein möchtest, das täglich an Lösungen für die Gesundheit von morgen arbeitet, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

jobs.title: CQV Ingenieur / Qualifizierungs- und Validierungsspezialist 80-100% (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Sofern erforderlich, steht berechtigten Kandidaten und ihren Familien Unterstützung beim Umzug zur Verfügung.

Als CQV Ingenieur (m/w/d) bist Du für die Qualifizierung und Validierung von verfahrenstechnischem Equipment und Einrichtungen verantwortlich. Du trägst massgebend zur laufenden Optimierung von Prozessen, Anlagen und internen Abläufen bei. Du bist für die Sicherstellung des nötigen fachtechnischen Wissensstands des Anlagepersonals sowie der Engineering-Gruppen mitverantwortlich.

Deine Karriere bei Lonza in Visp

Was wir Dir bieten:

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur

• Ein integrativer und ethischer Arbeitsplatz

• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung anerkennen

• Neben einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt erwarten Sie zahlreiche Vorteile in den Bereichen Lifestyle, Familie und Freizeit. Die vollständige Liste unserer globalen Leistungen finden Sie auch unter: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

Deine Aufgaben:

• Erstellen von Inbetriebnahme- und Qualifizierungsunterlagen für Neuanlagen, sowie die Betreuung von Umbau-, Ausbau- und Neubauprojekten; aufgegliedert wird dies in PQs auf Neubauprojekten für kritische Systeme und die SLC Betreuung aller Systeme nach der Produktivstellung

• Betreuung von Abweichungen, Änderungen (GEP und GMP), sowie CAPAs

• Koordination von internen Gruppen, sowie externen Dienstleistern und Lieferanten

• Verantwortung für die Präsentation der Qualifizierungsunterlagen bei Audits und Inspektionen

Dein Anforderungsprofil:

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung (ETH, FH, HF) ODER vergleichbare Berufserfahrung

• Gute Berufserfahrung im regulierten Umfeld bezüglich Inbetriebnahme, Qualifizierung und Validierung z.B. Kühl- und Gefrierschränke, Reinmedienräume, sowie verfahrenstechnischem Equipment - ein Vorteil

• Gute Kenntnisse in Microsoft Office werden vorausgesetzt, Kenntnisse in COMOS (Plant Engineering Softwarelösung), DMS, TrackWise und SAP sind von Vorteil

• Deutsch (fliessend in Wort und Schrift) und Englisch (verhandlungssicher)

• Selbständiges und flexibles Arbeiten mit gutem Kommunikationsstil, ausserdem strukturiertes, fokussiertes und gut organisiertes Arbeitsverhalten

​
Über Lonza:

Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeiter unsere größte Stärke. An über 30 Standorten auf fünf Kontinenten arbeiten unsere global vernetzten Teams täglich zusammen, um die Medikamente von morgen herzustellen. Unsere Grundwerte: Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortlichkeit, Exzellenz, Leidenschaft und Integrität spiegeln wider, wer wir sind und wie wir zusammenarbeiten. Die Ideen jedes Einzelnen, ob groß oder klein, haben das Potenzial, Millionen von Leben zu verbessern, und genau daran möchten wir Sie teilhaben lassen.

Innovation gedeiht, wenn Menschen unterschiedlichster Herkunft ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven einbringen. Bei Lonza schätzen wir Vielfalt und setzen uns für ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeiter ein. Wenn Sie bereit sind, die bahnbrechenden Ideen unserer Kunden in praktikable Therapien umzusetzen, freuen wir uns, Sie an Bord begrüßen zu dürfen.

Bereit, die Zukunft der Life Sciences mitzugestalten? Bewerben Sie sich jetzt.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

jobs.title: Operator pharmaceutical manufacturing 80-100%
jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Stein, AG, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Join our growing sterile Fill & Finish operations as an Operator and contribute to high‑quality manufacturing in a dynamic, expanding environment. Become part of an international team. We are currently working in day time (no shift), however around 2027/2028 a 2-shift model (early/late) will be introduced. Check out Your Career in Drug Product  Services at Lonza

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits can be found below.

• Benefits in Stein: https://bit.ly/42DlBDk

What you will do:

• Participation in qualification and validation of pharmaceutical production lines and processes (fill&finish lines) in a cleanroom

• Adherence to the relevant SOPs, EHS and GMP regulations

• Independent operation of the assigned parts of the fill&finish equipment and devices, including their pre‑ and post‑processing

• Execution of microbiological environmental monitoring, in‑process controls and sampling

• Identification and reporting of potential issues, as well as active support in continuous improvement processes

• Timely and GMP‑compliant documentation of all activities (e.g. in computer systems such as MES or in logbooks)

• Inspection of equipment, ensuring that it is cleaned and correctly stored

What we are looking for:

• Experience in pharmaceutical manufacturing within a GMP‑controlled, cleanroom environment is essential

• Exposure to aseptic Fill & Finish (vials or syringes) is a plus

• Completed vocational training in the pharmaceutical field is considered an advantage

• A detail‑oriented mindset, with GMP‑compliant work as a natural standard; you enjoy collaborating in a team and thrive in a dynamic environment

• Fluency in German as well as good skills in English are a prerequisite

• Willingness to work daytime initially and transition to a two‑shift model around 2027/2028

• Willingness to work in a cleanroom environment, including full gowning procedures

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.
Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.
Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

jobs.title: Laborant(in) / Automatiker 80-100% (m/w/d)

titleByLocale.it: Tecnico di laboratorio / Tecnico di automazione 80-100% (m/f/g)

jobs.description:
Lonza ist heute ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Life Sciences, welches auf fünf Kontinenten tätig ist. Wir sind in der Wissenschaft tätig, jedoch gibt es keine Zauberformel dafür, wie wir die Arbeit angehen. Unsere wichtigste wissenschaftliche Lösung sind talentierte Mitarbeitende, die zusammenarbeiten und Ideen entwickeln, die anderen Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Gegenzug steuern unsere Mitarbeitenden ihre Karriere selbstständig. Denn ihre Ideen, ob gross und klein, verbessern die Welt. Und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der wir Teil haben möchten.

Am Standort Visp  wird ein/eine Laborant/in – Automatiker/in gesucht.
Der Stelleninhaber ist für den Betrieb, die Instandhaltung, Störungsbehebung und Neu-Beschaffung von Laborgeräten und Laborautomaten verantwortlich.

Ihre Aufgaben

• Verwaltung, Kontrolle und Pflege aller zugeordneten Laborgeräte und ‑automaten in den Entwicklungs‑ und Prozessoptimierungslaboren

• Sicherstellung einer aktuellen und vollständigen Dokumentation aller Laborgeräte in SAP

• Instandhaltung, Störungsbehebung sowie Koordination von Neubeschaffungen und Upgrades des Laborgeräteparks

• Schulung der Laborteams in der fachgerechten Bedienung von Laborgeräten und Laborautomaten

• Pflege und Nachverfolgung der Gerätehistorie in SAP

Ihr Anforderungsprofil

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Laborant/in oder Automatiker/in

• Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Syntheselaborumfeld, idealerweise mit Fokus auf Laborautomatisation

• Erfahrung im Aufbau, in der Konfiguration und Anpassung von Laborautomaten

• Erfahrung in der Planung und Durchführung von Schulungen sowie in der Erstellung von Schulungsunterlagen

• Technisches Verständnis und handwerkliches Geschick für mechanische Anpassungen und Reparaturen an Laborgeräten

• Gutes Verständnis für Sicherheits‑ und Qualitätsstandards im Laborbetrieb

• Ausgeprägte Kommunikations‑ und Präsentationsfähigkeiten

• Teamfähigkeit sowie Freude an der Arbeit in einem dynamischen Umfeld

• Selbstständige, strukturierte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise

• Hohe Problemlösungsfähigkeit und technisches Verständnis

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

• Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil

Lonzas Produkte und Services wirken sich täglich positiv auf Millionen von Menschen aus. Für uns stellt dies nicht nur eine grosse Ehre, sondern auch eine grosse Verantwortung, dar. Wie wir unsere Geschäftsergebnisse erreichen ist für uns genauso wichtig wie unsere Erfolge selbst. Bei Lonza wird Respekt grossgeschrieben und wir schützen sowohl unsere Mitarbeiter als auch unsere Umwelt. Erfolg für uns bedeutet moralisch vertretbarer Fortschritt.

Zu Lonza kommen Menschen, die Herausforderungen annehmen und mit ihrer Kreativität im Bereich Life Science neue Ideen für komplexe Problemstellungen entwickeln. Zusammen leisten wir einen Beitrag, der das Leben vieler Menschen auf der ganzen Welt verbessern kann. Dies bietet ihnen die Gewissheit und die Zufriedenheit, mit der eigenen Arbeit wirklich einen Unterschied zu machen.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Stein, AG, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Join our growing Drug Product Services team and help shape the future of pharmaceutical manufacturing! In this role, you’ll take the lead and oversight on qualification and validation activities for state-of-the-art infrastructure and utilities (i.e. clean water (WFI and Purified water), clean steam, compressed gases (air and nitrogen), clean rooms (from CNC to class A), and HVAC) supporting our aseptic fill & finish lines. You’ll contribute to high-impact CAPEX and OPEX projects while ensuring inspection and operational readiness in a cutting-edge environment. Are you looking for a chance to be part of an international and supportive team? Apply today!

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits can be found below.

• Benefits in Stein: https://bit.ly/42DlBDk

What you will do:

• Act as responsible QA for establishment, execution and maintenance of infrastructure & clean utilities related qualification/validation activities in order to allow manufacturing of sterile medicinal products

• Acts as contact person for GMP related issues (deviations) and their proper handling in shared global QMS systems (e.g. Trackwise, Kneat)

• Ensure proper qualification strategy for infrastructure/ clean utilities by adherence to the corresponding site VMP(s), Regulatory requirements as well as Global and Local procedures during CAPEX and/or OPEX Projects

• Supervise activities like GMP status and trending of (re-) qualification/(re-) validation, adherence to global and local procedures for changes control management, deviations and CAPAs handling

• Act as SME for qualification related topics during audits and inspections

• Acts as contact person for qualification documents life cycle management e.g. approval of SOPs, qualification protocols and reports

What we are looking for:

• Solid experience in qualification and validation of clean utilities & facilities (i.e. clean water (WFI and Purified water), clean steam, compressed gases (air and nitrogen), clean rooms (from CNC to grade A) and HVAC) for aseptic drug product manufacturing in a GMP environment is a must

• Experience with health authorities Audit (e.g. Swissmedic, FDA) and Customer inspections

• Knowledge of regulatory guidelines GMP Annex 1, 11, 15

• Degree in life science (e.g. chemistry, biology, pharmacy) or equivalent experience

• You value working in a team, supporting your colleagues and contributing to a positive work culture is a matter of course to you

• Fluency in English is a must, German language skills are an advantage

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.
Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.
Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.
